evidence.detail: R15 GpuPlugin copies live GpuConfig values directly into rs/k/b static state, including R15 AntiAliasingMode, ColorBlindMode and VsyncMode plus UI scaling and GPU feature flags.

rs/k/b performs the actual GPU enable/disable transitions, preserving the exact strings "Initializing GPU - please wait.", "Disabling GPU - please wait.", "::gpuflagon" and "::gpuflagoff", and creates/tears down the live GPU renderer objects through Client.
The class owns the exact gpu.properties persistence path and the SaveGpuSettings task, with persisted stretch_width and stretch_height values loaded through java.util.Properties.
Direct exact-v308 consumers include Client, RSApplet, R15 GpuPlugin and the GPU renderer stack; configuration changes update this class and trigger renderer transitions through it.

proposals.note: GpuRuntimeSettings is a deliberately descriptive semantic name for the static GPU runtime settings/control bridge between R15 GpuConfig and the live renderer. It does not claim a verbatim original developer identifier.
